jobs.title: Food Receiver (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your key responsibilities

As a valued member of our Purchasing Team, you will contribute to the smooth running of our operations by taking responsibility for the following tasks:

  • Inspect all incoming deliveries against delivery notes and purchase orders, ensuring compliance with our high quality standards.

  • Ensure the proper storage of delivered goods whenever required.

  • Verify that all ordered goods have been received in full and liaise with suppliers in the event of any discrepancies.

  • Accurately process and record delivery notes in a timely manner.

  • Manage the distribution of Economat orders to the various hotel departments.

  • Ensure the accurate and systematic recording of internal stock transfers related to Economat supplies.

  • Monitor Economat stock levels, independently manage replenishment orders and ensure the continuous availability of supplies.

  • Oversee the organisation and maintenance of the goods receiving area, including the garage, storage rooms, empty containers, packaging materials, cleanliness and equipment management.

• What you bring to the job

  • You have completed professional training in Culinary Arts or Food & Beverage Service.

  • You have previous experience in an administrative role and demonstrate a structured, accurate and detail-oriented approach to your work.

  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

  • Ideally, you have experience working with an inventory management system; knowledge of Kost is considered an advantage.

  • You have an excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Italian or German is an additional asset.

  • You are highly motivated, resilient and quick to learn, with the ability to work independently and adopt a solution-oriented approach.

  • You demonstrate a professional appearance, excellent interpersonal skills and a friendly, courteous manner.

Our offer

  • Fixed-term seasonal position from the end of November 2026 until the beginning of April 2027, with the possibility of returning for future seasons

  • An average 5-day working week of 43.5 hours

  • 5 weeks of holiday and 6 public holidays per year

  • 13th-month salary from the start of employment (pro rata temporis)

  • Staff accommodation in one of our employee residences, subject to availability

  • Meals available in our modern staff restaurant

  • An attractive and international working environment with opportunities for professional development


If you are looking for an interesting, challenging, and varied role in a dynamic environment and would like to join a well-established team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.


Recruitment Fraud Warning
Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Le tue principali responsabilità

In qualità di membro stimato del nostro Team Acquisti, contribuirai al regolare svolgimento delle nostre attività assumendoti la responsabilità delle seguenti mansioni:

  • Ispezionare tutte le consegne in arrivo confrontandole con le bolle di consegna e gli ordini di acquisto, garantendo la conformità ai nostri elevati standard qualitativi.

  • Garantire la corretta conservazione delle merci consegnate quando necessario.

  • Verificare che tutte le merci ordinate siano state ricevute integralmente e contattare i fornitori in caso di discrepanze.

  • Elaborare e registrare accuratamente le bolle di consegna in modo tempestivo.

  • Gestire la distribuzione degli ordini Economat ai vari reparti dell'hotel.

  • Garantire la registrazione accurata e sistematica dei trasferimenti interni di scorte relativi alle forniture Economat.

  • Monitorare i livelli delle scorte Economat, gestire autonomamente gli ordini di reintegro e garantire la disponibilità continua delle forniture.

  • Supervisionare l'organizzazione e la manutenzione dell'area di ricevimento merci, inclusi il garage, i locali di stoccaggio, i contenitori vuoti, i materiali di imballaggio, la pulizia e la gestione delle attrezzature.

• Cosa porti al lavoro

  • Hai completato una formazione professionale in arti culinarie o nel servizio Food & Beverage.

  • Hai già maturato esperienza in un ruolo amministrativo e dimostri un approccio strutturato, preciso e orientato ai dettagli nel tuo lavoro.

  • Hai un'eccellente padronanza delle applicazioni Microsoft Office, in particolare di Excel.

  • Idealmente, hai esperienza nell'utilizzo di un sistema di gestione dell'inventario; la conoscenza di Kost è considerata un vantaggio.

  • Hai un'eccellente padronanza dell'inglese, sia scritto sia parlato. La conoscenza dell'italiano o del tedesco costituisce un ulteriore vantaggio.

  • Sei altamente motivato, resiliente e rapido nell'apprendimento, con la capacità di lavorare in autonomia e di adottare un approccio orientato alle soluzioni.

  • Dimostri un aspetto professionale, eccellenti capacità interpersonali e un atteggiamento amichevole e cortese.

La nostra offerta

  • Posizione stagionale a tempo determinato dalla fine di novembre 2026 fino all'inizio di aprile 2027, con possibilità di tornare per le stagioni successive

  • Una settimana lavorativa media di 5 giorni e 43.5 ore

  • 5 settimane di ferie e 6 giorni festivi all'anno

  • 13ª mensilità dall'inizio del rapporto di lavoro (pro rata temporis)

  • Alloggio per il personale in una delle nostre residenze per dipendenti, in base alla disponibilità

  • Pasti disponibili nel nostro moderno ristorante per il personale

  • Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e internazionale con opportunità di sviluppo professionale


Se cerchi un ruolo interessante, stimolante e vario in un ambiente dinamico e desideri entrare a far parte di un team consolidato, saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura online completa.

Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben

  • Prüfen Sie alle eingehenden Lieferungen anhand der Lieferscheine und Bestellungen und stellen Sie sicher, dass unsere hohen Qualitätsstandards eingehalten werden.

  • Stellen Sie bei Bedarf die ordnungsgemäße Lagerung der gelieferten Waren sicher.

  • Überprüfen Sie, ob alle bestellten Waren vollständig eingegangen sind, und stimmen Sie sich bei Abweichungen mit den Lieferanten ab.

  • Bearbeiten und erfassen Sie Lieferscheine zeitnah und präzise.

  • Verwalten Sie die Verteilung der Economat-Bestellungen an die verschiedenen Hotelabteilungen.

  • Stellen Sie die genaue und systematische Erfassung interner Bestandsumbuchungen im Zusammenhang mit Economat-Artikeln sicher.

  • Überwachen Sie die Economat-Bestände, verwalten Sie eigenständig Nachbestellungen und stellen Sie die kontinuierliche Verfügbarkeit der Materialien sicher.

  • Überwachen Sie die Organisation und Instandhaltung des Wareneingangsbereichs, einschließlich der Garage, der Lagerräume, der leeren Behälter, der Verpackungsmaterialien, der Sauberkeit und der Geräteverwaltung.

• Was Sie für die Stelle mitbringen

  • Sie haben eine Berufsausbildung im Bereich Kochkunst oder im Service für Speisen und Getränke abgeschlossen.

  • Sie verfügen über Erfahrung in einer administrativen Funktion und zeichnen sich durch eine strukturierte, präzise und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise aus.

  • Sie sind versiert im Umgang mit den Anwendungen von Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel.

  • Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Erfahrung im Umgang mit einem Warenwirtschaftssystem; Kenntnisse in Kost gelten als Vorteil.

  • Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Italienisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse sind ein zusätzlicher Vorteil.

  • Sie sind hochmotiviert und belastbar, lernen schnell und können selbstständig sowie lösungsorientiert arbeiten.

  • Sie zeichnen sich durch ein professionelles Auftreten, ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und eine freundliche, zuvorkommende Art aus.

  • Befristete Saisonstelle von Ende November 2026 bis Anfang April 2027 mit der Möglichkeit, in künftigen Saisons zurückzukehren

  • Eine durchschnittliche 5-Tage-Arbeitswoche mit 43.5 Stunden

  • 5 Wochen Urlaub und 6 gesetzliche Feiertage pro Jahr

  • 13. Monatsgehalt ab Beginn des Arbeitsverhältnisses (anteilig)

Your key responsibilities

As Assistant Head of Technical Services, you support the Head of Technical Services in the operational management and ongoing development of all technical areas within our property. You help ensure the reliable, safe, and efficient operation of our infrastructure and assume responsibility for the department in their absence.

  • Coordination and supervision of daily technical operations, maintenance activities, and repairs.

  • Involvement in the planning and implementation of maintenance, investment, renovation, and construction projects.

  • Support in the organisation of the technical team’s daily assignments and in leading and developing team members.

  • Deputising for the Head of Technical Services during their absence.

  • Coordination and supervision of external service providers and contractors.

  • Support with cost monitoring, procurement, and investment planning.

  • Ensuring compliance with legal requirements, safety standards, and internal policies.

  • Close collaboration with all departments and contribution to the continuous improvement of technical processes, energy efficiency, and resource management.


• What you bring to the job

  • Completed technical training, ideally complemented by further education in building services engineering, facility management, or a related discipline.

  • Several years of professional experience in technical services or facility management, ideally within the hospitality sector or a similarly complex environment.

  • Experience in coordinating employees or small teams; initial leadership experience is an advantage.

  • Broad technical knowledge of building services, maintenance, energy efficiency, occupational safety, and technical infrastructure.

  • Experience in supporting or coordinating maintenance, renovation, or construction projects.

  • A structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented approach, combined with strong organisational and communication skills.

  • Confident use of digital tools.

  • A recognised qualification as a Safety Officer (SIBE) and/or Contact Person for Occupational Safety (KOPAS) is required.

  • A combination of at least two of the following languages is required: English, German, and Italian.

jobs.description:
Your key responsibilities

  • Leading the service team in Le Grand Hall, our iconic all-day dining venue and lounge, you will have operational responsibility for one of our hotel's signature dining venues, serving among other things authentic Indian cuisine and specialities from our pastry kitchen.

  • Daily restaurant operations, including table allocation and guest flow, will fall under your responsibility, ensuring both outstanding service and optimal operational performance.

  • Creating memorable guest experiences through warm hospitality and personalised service will be at the heart of your role.

  • Working closely with the Executive Chef, Bar team and other departments, you will maintain the highest standards in food and beverage presentation and service delivery.

  • You will take ownership of recruiting, developing and managing the service team, ensuring the highest levels of engagement, performance and service excellence.

  • Close collaboration with the Events team and other hotel departments will ensure the smooth execution of private functions and special occasions hosted in Le Grand Hall.

  • Supporting management with operational reporting, cost analysis, budgeting and forecasting will contribute to the ongoing success of the outlet.

• What you bring to the job

  • Several years of management experience within a luxury restaurant or five-star hotel, ideally in a Restaurant Manager or comparable leadership role.

  • A natural leader with the ability to motivate, inspire and develop teams while creating a positive and professional working environment.

  • A confident, polished and service-oriented personality, combined with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • A genuine passion for luxury hospitality and delivering personalised guest experiences of the highest standard.

  • Strong organisational skills, sound commercial awareness and the ability to remain calm and solution-oriented in a fast-paced environment.

  • Fluency in English is essential. Either German or Italian is required.

Our offer

  • 10-month contract, start to be discussed, with the possibility to renew from November 2027.

  • 5-day working week averaging 43.5 hours, with 5 weeks' holiday and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th month's salary from the start of employment (pro rata temporis).

  • Accommodation in one of our new staff houses.

  • Meals available in our new and modern staff restaurant.

  • Opportunity to work in an attractive environment with development and career growth opportunities.

If you are passionate about creating exceptional guest experiences and enjoy leading a team in one of Switzerland's most iconic luxury hotels, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.
